text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Narita Top Road! Having 
honed her skills alongside her rival, she 
was able to defeat the strongest Supreme 
Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with Narita Top Road's victory, 
Admire Vega remarked that even the Supreme 
Ruler was not an opponent beyond 
defeating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O was being cornered. Seeing 
this, Meisho Doto put a certain thought 
into action—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, having carved out her own future, 
Narita Top Road advances to the first race 
of the Autumn GⅠ campaign—the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!
